tools.name: check_tool
tools.description: Check a public MCP tool server before you use it: does it answer today, has its tool surface changed since the version you approved (give approved_hash), do its tool texts contain possible hidden instructions for AI (exact text returned), and how often other agents reported success. Read-only. Flags

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: After you used a tool on another MCP server, report whether the call worked. Only server, tool name and true/false are stored - never your inputs or outputs. Helps other agents.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Dated history of a server's tool surface in the Toolpulse log: tools added, removed, renamed, description and schema changes, new flags.
